html: I. שׁער (√ of foll.; Arabic ثَغَرَ break, break off, through, ثَعْرٌ gap, opening; Ethiopic ሰዐረ: tear in two, dissolve; Aramaic ܬܪܰܥ (transp.) split, divide, תְּרַע tear down; NH שַׁעַר gate, so MI 22 שעריה (pl. sf.), Ph. שער Lzb381; TelAm. šaḫri, as Canaanism, Wkl195, 1. 16; Aramaic תַּרְעָא, ܬܰܪܥܳܐ: Nab. תרעא Lzb388;—Egyptian šạār is loan-word Bondi70).
